🔄 I'd swap pushdowns for Lateral Raise. It puts very little load on the elbow and still works your pushing day. The other triceps options in the library, dips and overhead extensions, usually stress the elbow more, so I'd skip them today.

⚠️ Keep the weight light and stay pain-free. Your bench and overhead press also load the elbow, so drop the weight or skip them if they hurt. If the pain is sharp or lingers, stop and see a professional.
